holes.reason: this response reads at most 10000 spans of the run tree and the tree holds more: the later spans were not read, nothing was lost
holes.fix: open a child run's own tree (runs/{id}/spans?tree=1 on the child), or its spans (runs/{id}/spans)

holes.reason: this run's spans carry no run id, so its tree is cut from its trace, and this response reads at most the trace's first 50000 spans: a span of the tree after them was not read, nothing was lost
holes.fix: open the trace (traces/{trace_id}), or a child run's own tree

holes.reason: 101 finished descendant runs have a row and no span in this tree: it ran without a tracer, or a destination dropped its spans (the first 1 by start are named)
runs of this tree carry another public id, or none: a panel token reads its own public id's runs, so their spans and their subtrees' are left out
holes.fix: open the tree with the server (dev) token
